d: DM NVX® 5K 4x1 AV-over-IP Switcher with HDMI® andUSB-C® Connectivity

specs.label: Video Resolutions
specs.value: Up to 5120x2160 @30 Hz (5K Ultra-Wide) or 5120x1440 @60 Hz (5K Super-Wide); Up to 4:4:4 color sampling; HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, and Deep Color support

specs.label: Encoding/Decoding audio formats
specs.value: Primary multichannel (up to 8-channel LPCM or encoded HBR 7.1 surround sound), secondary 2-channel LPCM

specs.label: Input Signal Types
specs.value: HDMI with HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, Deep Color, and 5K support (Dual-Mode DisplayPort™ interface and DVI compatible); DisplayPort over USB-C (DisplayPort Alt Mode) with HDR10, HDR10+, and 5K support

specs.label: Output Signal Types
specs.value: HDMI with HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, Deep Color, and 5K support (DVI compatible)

specs.label: Switcher
specs.value: 4x1 in encoder mode (Two HDMI, Two USB-C), manual or auto-switching, breakaway audio, Crestron QuickSwitch HD™ technology

specs.label: Scaler (Decoder Mode Only)
specs.value: 5K video scaler with motion-adaptive deinterlacing, intelligent frame rate conversion, Deep Color support, HDR10, HDR10+, and Dolby Vision support, widescreen format selection (zoom, stretch, maintain aspect ratio
